verdict.rationale: Hatchet's own SDK reference shows some programmatic management, such as creating and managing cron triggers and evaluating CEL expressions. Its CLI and TUI offer non-web access to tasks, workflows and workers. Nothing in the evidence documents that the API matches everything the UI can do, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a published OpenAPI/REST reference covering all UI operations, and independent confirmation that UI-only features are reachable via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Create and manage cron triggers that run workflows on a schedule
Evaluate and debug CEL expressions used in event filters and concurrency keys
provides real-time observability into tasks, workflows, workers, and more
